question: The Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, was formerly known as __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Victoria Terminus Station.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus was formerly known as **Victoria Terminus Station.**
 
• The Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT) is a** historic railway station in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.**
 
• The station was built in** 1887 to commemorate the Golden Jubilee of Queen Victoria and was named Victoria Terminus Station.**
 
• ** In 1996, **the station was renamed **Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus (CST) in honour of the Maratha king Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.**
 
• In 2017, the station was again renamed as Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT) to include the honorific Maharaj in the name.
 
• **The station is a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its Victorian-Gothic architecture.**
